'''Kendrick Summers''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold Leader from Decipher Inc. The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. He later appeared as a regular SWCCG organized-play guest (Endor, DecipherCon).

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
